_readme: Armor-as-body-parts test. Each subject is ONE equipment piece; its 'slot' pulls the real drawing rule + negatives from prompt-templates.json. Rules under test: chest = no hands/head, head = no face, legs = no feet, and no other slot's gear. Styles are three of the user's round-1/2 favourites. 2 seeds each to judge reliability.
name: pieces1
title: Piece test: individual equipment pieces (columns) x styles (rows), 2 seeds
framing: single subject centered, entire subject visible, plain flat light grey background
palette: warm golden saturated palette, early frontier era
negative: text, letters, watermark, signature, logo, border, frame, cropped, cut off, busy background, scenery, landscape, ground, environment, blurry, lowres, jpeg artifacts, deformed

styles.label: Painterly, crisp edges
styles.prompt: visible brushstrokes, soft blended gradients, crisp clean defined edges, thin dark outline around the silhouette, high readability
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, vector, blurry edges
